description:
Make a reused gate verdict name the issue its source run belongs to as well as the run, so the source record is addressable without searching.

## Background

`GateVerdictOrigin::Reused(String)` (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:1046-1063`, accessor `source_run()` at `:1085-1090`) names the source run by id alone and serializes adjacently tagged as `{"derivation": "reused", "source_run": "<run-id>"}`. Under per-issue run records the id alone does not locate the record.

Producers and readers: `reused_gate_run` (`commands/gate_check.rs:36-60`, called at `:921`); the human render at `main.rs:1190-1191`; the generated storage-record reference (`storage/reference.rs:264` prose and `:363` sample), whose committed output `docs/reference/storage-records.md:100-101,142` is checked by `test_committed_reference_matches_projection` (`reference.rs:817`); tests at `commands/gate_check.rs:2334-2491`. This repository holds 123 reused run records in the old shape. Kept as one change for a golden-test reason: the reference sample constructs the variant, so the committed reference is regenerated in the same commit.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `GateVerdictOrigin::Reused` carries `source_issue: IssueId` and `source_run: GateRunId` and serializes as `{"derivation": "reused", "source_issue": "<issue-id>", "source_run": "<run-id>"}`. A record without `source_issue` fails to decode.
- [hard] REQ-02: Reuse sets `source_issue` to the issue the source run belongs to, and the human gate-status render names both.
- [hard] REQ-03: The reference sample and its prose show the new shape, and the committed reference matches the projection.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
- Stored reused records in the old shape are rewritten by the repository's one-time gate-run rewrite, which lands with this change.
title: Reused verdicts name their source issue and source run
